name: Jinan Wildlife World (济南野生动物世界)
verdict: Jinan Wildlife World is a park managed and operated by Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group, a first-level municipal state-owned enterprise of Jinan, which also lists Jinan Wildlife World Co., Ltd. among its investments. Back-of-shirt sponsor of Shandong Taishan for the 2026 CSL season.

why.text: Jinan Wildlife World, advertised on the back of the shirt, is managed and operated by Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group, a first-level municipal state-owned enterprise established by the Jinan municipal government. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that serious human rights violations were committed against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. So the money behind the back of the shirt is the Chinese state's.
why.messageLine: The UN human rights office found that China’s large-scale arbitrary detention of Uyghurs in Xinjiang may amount to crimes against humanity.

note: Back-of-shirt sponsor of Shandong Taishan in the 2026 Chinese Super League season (named press: Tencent News / 九五体育, 2026-03-17). Rating note: proposed 'serious' — the Chinese state controls the sponsor (the link, claims jinan-wildlife-world-jctg-operations + jctg-jinan-sasac-ownership: the park is managed and operated by Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group, which lists Jinan Wildlife World Co., Ltd. among its investments, and the group is a first-level municipal state-owned enterprise established by the Jinan municipal government; METHOD.md counts control), and the record (claim china-xinjiang-un-assessment: UN OHCHR 2022 Xinjiang assessment plus Human Rights Watch 2026) is documented for that state. ON HOLD: awaits a maintainer's review (tier set by maintainers). Further detail, kept out of the rating claims: a single report (山东财经报道, carried 2026-07-21 by Sohu/金融界 and The Paper) states the Jinan municipal SASAC holds 93.19% of the group and is its largest shareholder and actual controller (Shandong Caixin Asset Operation 6.81%); no second independent publisher for that sentence was found, so the tier rests on the municipal-SOE ownership claim instead.
